symptom: The first acceptance run remained pending after the offline probe invoked a reducer on an explicitly disconnected SDK connection.
cause: The harness awaited a promise for an operation the SDK neither accepted nor immediately rejected while disconnected.
retainedObservation: Warm in-memory rows remained readable after disconnect; this does not establish persistent offline support.
remediation: Bound the disconnected-operation observation to 250 ms, retain its exact outcome, and never treat a pending call as queued or accepted.
targetRecovery: Delete and recreate only the exact isolated arm database because the interrupted run had already committed acceptance mutations.
